Subject: Publicity & Confidentiality: approval matrix + evidence for Acme MSA

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the productive sync today. As we discussed, Acme is nearly ready to sign the MSA + Order Form, but your legal team flagged a few publicity and confidentiality items that we want to resolve before the final sign. I attached our redlines (ACME_MSA_Redlines_v3.pdf) and a short evidence checklist we use for publicity approvals.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Acme will accept the proposed three-tier publicity matrix (see p.7 of the redlines) that differentiates: product launch quotes, logo in case studies, and press releases?
- If yes, can Ethan (or whoever on legal) confirm what documentary evidence Acme requires for each tier (e.g., final press release, screenshot of marketing asset, PO / purchase evidence)?

If it helps, Marissa on our marketing ops team is prepared to produce a sample checklist and asset templates. We want to avoid open-ended "reference rights" language that would require legal review for every small product mention.

I can jump on a 20-min call tomorrow if you want to walk through the matrix.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Publicity & Confidentiality: approval matrix + evidence for Acme MSA

Jordan / team —

Thanks for sending the redlines. I reviewed the publicity section. High level comments:
1) The three-tier matrix is reasonable, but we need clearer language about the approval timeline for Tier 1 (press releases with quotes). Specifically, Acme requires a 5 business-day review window for any press release that uses an Acme quote or positions Acme as a strategic customer.
2) For logo usage, we can accept a one-time approved asset per co-marketing activity, but need a clause that states Acme can withdraw approval with 30 days' notice if brand guidelines are violated.
3) The proposed "reference rights" clause is too broad; we will accept case studies and customer badges provided they are reviewed and redacted for confidential metrics. We cannot agree to perpetual, unrestricted testimonial usage.

Evidence we will accept (minimum):
- Tier 1 (press release with quote): final press release + context doc + draft social posts.
- Tier 2 (case study with metrics): final case study + proof of purchase / contract reference + redaction plan if required.
- Tier 3 (logo, badges): approved art file + landing page mockup.

I attached inline comments to the PDF. Happy to align on specific wording.

Regards,
Ethan Ross
Sr. Counsel, Acme Cloud
[Attachment: ACME_MSA_Redlines_v3.pdf (annotated, 158KB)]

Looping Marissa (marketing ops) into the thread today — draft templates attached for what Acme requested.

Notes for internal:
- We can support a 5-business-day review for press releases, but that will require us to lock a point of contact on Acme's side for rapid turn. We should push for a "no-significant-edit" norm unless legal requires changes.

- For case studies with metrics: suggest that we include an explicit redaction window (48 hours) for sensitive metrics followed by a final sign-off from Acme.

Subject: Re: Publicity & Confidentiality: approval matrix + evidence for Acme MSA

Ethan / Samantha —

Thanks for the quick review and the annotated PDF. We can accept the 5-business-day review window for Tier 1. To keep signoff predictable, suggested operational language:

- Acme will provide approval or written comments within 5 business days of receipt of the final press release. Failure to respond within 5 business days constitutes approval.
- For logo withdrawal, Acme will notify Redwood in writing with specific brand guideline violations; Redwood will have 30 days to remediate before the asset is removed.
- Case studies with metrics will go through a 48-hour redaction window, after which Acme will provide final sign-off in writing.

If Acme agrees to the above, we will update the MSA wording and circulate for final sign. I can produce a short matrix table (who sends what, expected artifacts, and signoff timelines) and attach it to the order form as a referenced exhibit — will that work for legal?

If yes, please confirm and we will push the updated MSA + Exhibit A to DocuSign by Friday.

Appreciate it —
Jordan
